description.value: Cirrhosis of the River is a self-catering glamping cabin near Chilliwack, British Columbia, listed on Airbnb as 'Eco Retreat Cabin 1.' It appears to be part of a small eco-retreat property with at least one bookable cabin unit. As an Airbnb-only listing with no traditional front desk or staff, the experience would be independently managed by the host.
